description: This file attaches behaviors for the Drupal Field UI module, including form modifications, AJAX handling, and UI interactions for managing field display and configuration.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches behaviors to the form and overview table, modifies form classes, and sets up AJAX submit button handling.

methods.name: regionChange
methods.description: Handles changing the region of a field row, updating the UI and preparing for AJAX refresh.

methods.name: AJAXRefreshRows
methods.description: Triggers AJAX refresh for specified rows, showing throbbers and disabling inputs during the request.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the current region value for a field row.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Initializes drag-and-drop and row handlers for the display overview table.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles change events on form inputs to update row regions and trigger AJAX refresh.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles row drop events in drag-and-drop, updating regions and triggering AJAX refresh.

methods.name: onSwap
methods.description: Handles visual updates when rows are swapped during drag-and-drop.
